The base of the isosceles triangle is the base of the parallelogram, i.e. 27 units.

And the isosceles triangle is constructed between the parallel lines of the parallelogram. So, the altitude of that triangle becomes the vertical distance between the parallel lines.

Now, the area of the triangle = 1/2 x base x altitude = 648 square units.

Or,1/2 x 27 x altitude = 648

Therefore, altitude = 648 * 2/ 27 = 48 units. Hence, option 4.

questions.question: If tanq + cotq = 2, then what is the value of tan 7 q + cot 7 q? यदि tanq + cotq = 2 है, तो tan 7 q + cot 7 q का मान क्या है?
questions.questionHtml:
If tanq + cotq = 2, then what is the value of tan7 q + cot7 q?

यदि tanq + cotq = 2 है, तो tan7 q + cot7 q का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
∵ tanq +cotq =2

tan q + 1/tan q = 2

tan2q - 2 tan q + 1 = 0 or (tan q - 1)2 = 0

So, tanq = 1

tan7 q + cot7 q = 1 + 1 = 2

Let the speeds of train and car be T km/h and C km/h respectively.

According to question,

100_________(T - 6) x (5/18)
  = 5 

T - 6 = 100 x 18/(5x5) = 72

T = 78 km/hr

100_________(T - C) x (5/18)
  = 6 

T - C = 18 x 100/(5 x 6) = 60

C = 78 - 60 = 18

Hence, speed of car is 18 km/h.

questions.questionHtml:
Evaluate:  
[2(1 - sin θ) - cos2 θ] x [2(1 + sin θ) - cos2 θ]_________cos4 θ
मूल्यांकन करें:  
[2(1 - sin θ) - cos2 θ] x [2(1 + sin θ) - cos2 θ]_________cos4 θ
questions.solution:
2(1 - sin θ) - cos2 θ

= 2(1 - sin θ) - (1 - sin 2θ)

= 2(1 - sin θ) - (1 - sin θ)(1 + sin θ)

= (1 - sin θ)(2 - 1 - sin θ) = (1 - sin θ)2

2(1 + sin θ) - cos2 θ

= 2(1 + sin θ) - (1 - sin 2θ)

= 2(1 + sin θ) - (1 - sin θ)(1 + sin θ)

= (1 + sin θ)(2 - 1 + sin θ) = (1 + sin θ)2

So, numerator becomes: (1 - sin θ)2 x (1 + sin θ)2

= [(1 - sin θ)(1 + sin θ)]2 = (cos2 θ)2

= cos4 θ

So required value = cos4 θ/cos4 θ = 1
